clean_otsl_tags: clean OTSL tag list by removing padding, unknown, start, and end tokens
check_table_square: check if an OTSL tag sequence forms a square table structure
pad_table_to_square: pad a non-square OTSL tag sequence to a square table with a specified pad tag
convert_otsl_to_html: convert OTSL tag sequence to HTML table structure with colspan and rowspan support
convert_html_to_otsl: convert HTML table structure to OTSL tag sequence with span metadata
